Package com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim

Record Class LimelightNTInputs

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim.LimelightNTInputs
Record Components:
pipeline - requested pipeline index (key pipeline).
ledMode - requested LED mode (key ledMode).
throttle - frames to skip between captures (key throttle_set).
robotHeading - robot yaw for MegaTag2, from robot_orientation_set.
fiducialIdFilters - ids valid for localization, from fiducial_id_filters_set; empty means "no filter".
cameraPoseOverride - robot->camera transform requested by camerapose_robotspace_set, if the robot wrote one.
public record LimelightNTInputs(int pipeline, int ledMode, int throttle, Optional<edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Rotation2d> robotHeading, int[] fiducialIdFilters, Optional<edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Transform3d> cameraPoseOverride) extends Record
What the robot code writes to the Limelight over NetworkTables.

A real Limelight is not only a data source: it also reads keys the robot writes to configure it on the fly. The simulation reads and honours them so that the same code calling LimelightHelpers.SetRobotOrientation or SetFiducialIDFiltersOverride takes effect here too.
